$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs (CI `dependency-audit` job). Entries accept a KNOWN high/critical advisory that cannot be fixed without a tracked breaking upgrade. Every entry needs: ghsa (the advisory id, any case — one entry can never cover anything else), reason, trackedBy (GitHub issue), expires (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC — an expired entry with a live advisory FAILS the gate; renew only with re-triage). package/severity are optional documentation fields; the gate warns when severity drifts from the live advisory. Policy: docs/internal/security/SECURITY_FIXES.md § npm audit sweep + CI gate.

entries.reason: ICNS parser infinite-loop DoS in image-size, reachable only through the Expo/Metro bundler toolchain (dev/build-time, not production runtime). Fix requires the Expo SDK 57 major upgrade.
JXL/HEIF parser infinite-loop DoS in image-size, same Expo/Metro build-time chain as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr. Fix requires the Expo SDK 57 major upgrade.

postcss arbitrary-file-read via sourceMappingURL, in the copy nested under @expo/metro-config (build-time). The app-facing postcss copies (web/landing/vite) are already on patched versions; only the Expo chain pins the vulnerable one. Fix requires the Expo SDK 57 major upgrade.
postcss path traversal via source-map auto-loading, same @expo/metro-config nested copy as GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q. Fix requires the Expo SDK 57 major upgrade.
